hero.title: Insights for Building and Growing a Business in Romania
hero.intro: Practical perspectives on market entry, recruitment, operations and business development for international companies considering Romania.

articles.title: Thinking About Entering the Romanian Market? Start With These 5 Questions
articles.excerpt: Before you commit budget and headcount to Romania, five questions worth answering first.
articles.metaDescription: Before entering the Romanian market, international companies should answer five practical questions about demand, structure, talent and timing.
articles.ctaTitle: Planning to enter the Romanian market?
articles.body:
[Placeholder — full article text to be added.] Entering a new market is rarely a single decision — it is a series of smaller ones, each shaping how smoothly the next stage goes. Before committing budget, time or a first hire to Romania, it is worth pausing on a handful of practical questions.

This article will walk through five of them: what the real opportunity looks like, how the market actually works day to day, what kind of local presence is needed, how soon a team should be in place, and what “success” looks like in the first twelve months.

articles.title: Setting Up a Company in Romania Is the Easy Part. Building the Operation Is What Matters.
articles.excerpt: Incorporation is a formality. What actually determines success is everything that happens after it.
articles.metaDescription: Company formation in Romania is straightforward. The real work — and the real risk — is in building the operation around it.
articles.body:
[Placeholder — full article text to be added.] Registering a company in Romania can be done in a matter of days. Banking, accounting, suppliers, office infrastructure and a functioning local team take considerably longer — and are what actually determine whether the operation works.

This article looks at the gap between incorporation and operation, and what international companies typically underestimate when they treat company formation as the finish line rather than the starting point.

articles.title: Hiring in Romania: What International Companies Should Know Before Building a Local Team
articles.excerpt: Romania's talent pool is strong — but hiring well here still depends on knowing how the market actually works.
articles.metaDescription: What international companies should know about the Romanian talent market, hiring timelines and team building before recruiting locally.
articles.body:
[Placeholder — full article text to be added.] Romania offers a deep, well-educated talent pool across technology, engineering, finance and business services — but building a team here still requires understanding local hiring norms, compensation expectations and timelines.

This article covers what international companies should know before recruiting their first Romanian hires, from sourcing and interviewing through to onboarding and retention.

articles.title: Why Romania? When Does It Make Sense to Build Your Next European Operation Here?
articles.excerpt: Romania is not the right market for every company — but for the right profile, the case is compelling.
articles.metaDescription: When does Romania make sense as the base for a company's next European operation? A practical look at the fit, not just the pitch.
articles.ctaTitle: Considering Romania for your next European operation?
articles.body:
[Placeholder — full article text to be added.] Romania is increasingly considered by international companies as a base for European operations — for its EU access, talent pool, cost structure and location. But it is not automatically the right fit for every company or every stage of growth.

This article looks at the profile of companies for whom Romania tends to make the most sense, and the signs that suggest it is worth a closer look.
